en: Night view of a large, square stone building with a high greenish dome and small arched windows, illuminated by warm lights. Red light trails from passing cars streak across the cobblestone street in the foreground, indicating a long‑exposure photograph. The back side is a standard divided postcard layout with printed multilingual captions and publisher information.
